Filed by the 18.0 QA wave dispatch session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi` on the maintainer's instruction there, verbatim: 「立那 2 张漏掉的缺陷卡」 (the run had recorded it as an observation, not a card).

## What is wrong

`POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member` with a `role` outside the closed vocabulary is refused, but the refusal carries only a message (the text `ROLE_NOT_FOUND:` followed by the role name) and no machine `code`. A client written to ADR-0112's rule — branch on `error.code`, never on prose — can never recognise it.

The contract says it is coded:

- `packages/spec/src/identity/organization.zod.ts` — the invitation schema's `role` docstring: "A name outside it is refused at the door (`ROLE_NOT_FOUND`) before any invitation row exists."
- `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` — the same refusal named as `ROLE_NOT_FOUND`.
- ADR-0112 — refusals carry a code from the error-code vocabulary.

## Reproduction

1. Stock showcase boot with `--seed-admin`; sign in as the admin.
2. `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member` with body `{"email":"qa-invitee@example.com","role":"no_such_role"}`.
3. Expected: a 400 whose error carries `code: "ROLE_NOT_FOUND"`. Actual: a 400 whose error carries the message `ROLE_NOT_FOUND: no_such_role` and no `code`.

Control: `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/update-member-role` with an unknown role answers with a `code` — the same vendor family codes it on that door.

## Mechanism

The refusal is thrown by the vendored better-auth organization plugin (its invite route throws a `BAD_REQUEST` APIError with only a message), and plugin-auth passes it through without mapping it to a code; `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` is not in the error-code ledger. Expected fix shape: plugin-auth maps this vendor refusal to `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` (registering it in the ledger), so the door answers what the spec docstring promises — the spec is the baseline when spec and code disagree.
